title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: RBAC v2 introduced region-aware constraints for KMS keys and data residency policies. During the Dedicated/Private rollout we've seen ambiguous behavior when users create access policies that reference cross-region KMS aliases; this can lead to silent key-fallbacks and un-audited envelope key usage. This PR enforces region-pinning semantics for KMS-backed encryption keys, upgrades audit logging to emit structured events for KMS decisions, and hardens policy validation to prevent mismatches between resource region and allowed KMS regions.

What this change does: - Adds an enforcement layer in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator that verifies the KMS key region matches the resource region (or explicitly allowed region list) before allowing crypto operations. - Introduces structured audit events (kms_region_check) emitted to the audit-log pipeline whenever a KMS policy is evaluated, including outcome, matched_rule, and resolved_key_region. - Extends the RBAC policy schema to allow an explicit kms_regions field on principal and resource rules; validation errors are surfaced at policy creation time. - Adds migration script to scan existing customer policies and emit a report (and proposed fix suggestions) for policies that rely on cross-region KMS aliases. - Adds unit and integration tests covering evaluator logic, audit event contents, and backward-compatible schema parsing.

Checklist: - [x] Policy evaluator enforcement implemented - [x] Audit event emission + schema documented - [x] Migration scan and report script included - [x] Unit/integration tests - [x] Docs updated (console + API) - [x] E2E regression test in perf-canary

Risk/rollback notes: Enforcement is gated behind a rollout feature-flag (rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce) by default in the Private tenant. For Hosted customers we will progressively enable enforcement starter scope after a monitoring window. The migration script is read-only and only suggests fixes; it will not change customer policies without an opt-in. Rollback: disable the feature-flag and revert the evaluator enforcement commit.

Related: Linear ENG-9321, SEC-1184. Support ticket SUP-2042 reported a customer using cross-region KMS aliasing that triggered an incident.

Release notes: Harden RBAC v2 to validate KMS region alignment and emit structured audit events for KMS policy decisions. Migration tooling included to surface problematic policies.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Please make sure the evaluator uses the resolved region from the KMS client rather than naive parsing of the key ARN; we had an incident when aliases pointed to different partitions.
Aisha Patel: Addressed: evaluator now resolves key metadata via kms.GetKeyMetadata and caches result for request lifecycle. Added unit test to cover partition scenario.
Maya Singh: The audit schema looks good. Can you include the policy rule id in the event so we can correlate to policy changes in the console?
Aisha Patel: Included policy_rule_id and added console link helper in the event serializer. Updated docs with sample event and example Splunk query.
Evan Brooks: Migration script could be noisy. Add a severity score and grouping by customer to avoid excessive paging from infra alerts.
Aisha Patel: Added severity scoring heuristics and grouped output. Script now emits a per-customer summary CSV and a detailed JSON for engineering use.
Maya Singh: Can we gate enforcement for hosted tenants behind an opt-in to avoid breaking managed customers?
Aisha Patel: Yes: kept enforcement behind rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce flag and added telemetry to monitor failures and blocked operations. Default: disabled for hosted until post-rollout review.
release_notes: Harden RBAC v2 to validate and enforce that KMS keys are region-aligned with resources. Structured audit events (kms_region_check) added. Migration scan tool included to help surface cross-region policies.
